faces.name: Legacy Weapon
faces.oracleText:
{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}: Exile target permanent.
If Legacy Weapon would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, reveal Legacy Weapon and shuffle it into its owner's library instead.

faces.name: Legacy's Allure
faces.oracleText:
At the beginning of your upkeep, you may put a treasure counter on this enchantment.
Sacrifice this enchantment: Gain control of target creature with power less than or equal to the number of treasure counters on this enchantment. (This effect lasts indefinitely.)

faces.name: Legate Lanius, Caesar's Ace
faces.oracleText:
Decimate — When Legate Lanius enters, each opponent sacrifices a tenth of the creatures they control of their choice, rounded up.
Whenever an opponent sacrifices a creature, put a +1/+1 counter on Legate Lanius.
